brief: A compact desk unit with a drawer, plus a spike at a corner where three bases meet to hold a small platform.

requirements.requirement: Compact desk unit that includes a drawer.
requirements.evidence: Half base north at (-1,0) carries one drawer (drawer:0#-1,0#cut, key s) on its cut face, beside three full bases at (0,0), (0,1), (1,0).

requirements.requirement: A spike sits at a corner where three bases meet, so the spike has a junction to stand on.
requirements.evidence: spike:0#0,0|0,1|1,0, a mount spike at the junction of full bases (0,0), (0,1) and (1,0).

requirements.requirement: The spike holds a small platform (spike platform accessory, small size).
requirements.evidence: setSpikeAccessory platform-sm on the mount spike; BOM lists Platform, small (spike-acc-platform-sm). The large platform was not used. Mount type was required; the default solid spike refused a platform.
8 build nodes in total (4 bases, 1 drawer, 1 spike, 2 joint bolts); BOM printed instances 10.

finish.summary: Built a compact four-base unit: three full bases in a triangle at (0,0), (0,1), (1,0) plus a north half base at (-1,0). A drawer sits on the half base's cut face. A mount-type spike sits at the three-base corner and carries a small platform. Two joint bolts lock the loose bases; check_build is clean with meshClash clear, leaving only an info note that some faces could take caps (not added). Bolts are hand-tight M6 per the BOM note. The drawer only offered after the half base was oriented north; the cap info was left unaddressed since the brief did not ask for it.

lines.label: M3 x 10 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
